reviewScope: Direct reading of all 42 local observation boards and their 246 nominal half-second samples, plus selected native-player observations. This is a source inventory, not adopted footage or final-video approval.
samplingCaveat: fps=2 labels were assigned as index*0.5+0.25. These labels are nominal observation locations, not verified source frame PTS or cut boundaries. A native seek near Ballionaire 35 seconds showed a tooltip rather than the neighboring board's hole-board image. Exact boundaries require native-frame/PTS review before adoption.

observations.visible: Branding and promotional material.
Balls collide with objects on triangular and circular boards; trails and fictional $1/$200/$400/$800 x2 labels appear.

observations.limits: HUD is cropped; do not claim a whole-run total, final outcome or real money.

observations.connection: Multiple local event amounts need to be distinguished from an aggregate score.

observations.visible: Ice Cubes/Whale/Dam tooltips.
observations.decision: Text-only descriptions do not prove their effect and do not fill actual-play time.

observations.visible: Water-themed circular board, moving balls, $800 labels and a 90/90 to 93/93 counter.
observations.limits: Counter meaning is not inferred as bank, victory or internal formula.

observations.visible: Master Each Board promotional text.
Three-board montage, 7/7 counter, $1600/$3200 amounts and coin/ball actions on curved boards.
observations.limits: Different cuts are not a continuous causal sequence; fictional currency is not real gambling or financial loss.

observations.visible: Dark character and Make Cool Combos promotional material.
Split ghost/fire/water boards followed by moving balls on a fire triangle; $100/$200/$1600 popups.
observations.limits: No causal continuity between split boards or proof of an optimal combination.

observations.limits: Intermediate cropped values cannot alone establish an exact equation or final win.

observations.visible: Another game-over screen and taunt.
